patch_description: Replace the forced four-corner square hull with a fixed equilateral triangular hull. For an affine-area-normalized Heilbronn objective, a three-vertex hull removes an unnecessary boundary point and permits ten independently optimized interior points. The equilateral hull also aligns with the common three-fold structure of strong triangle-packing configurations. Candidate points are projected into this hull, keeping its area fixed and making raw minimum-area optimization equivalent to normalized optimization. Additional deterministic restarts compensate for the changed, less grid-like search landscape.
